title: Monotone Bounded-Influence Second Stage
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $t$ be a positive rational influence bound, let $0<\varepsilon\leq 1/2$ be a rational learning parameter, and let $J$ be a set of coordinates among the $n$ coordinates. Define the second-stage random-example learning program to run the bounded finite-family Fourier estimator on the selected family of subsets of $J$, using accuracy parameter $\varepsilon$ and the family-size bound prescribed by $t$ and $\varepsilon$, and to return a sparse Fourier hypothesis.
caveat: The selected family, learning-consequences family bound, and estimator program definitions are not included in the payload.
